PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: Independent quality and receiver signatures authenticate the current sensor log and calibration; both are current. All non-temperature release prerequisites are satisfied. Neither signature grants an exception to the temperature band.

PRIMARY.independent_evidence: Signed raw peak 8.2 C; calibrated offset minus 0.2 C. All other readings and conditions are acceptable. Release band 2.0–8.0 C inclusive; no exceptional quality release is needed.
PRIMARY.release_rule: Release requires corrected temperature between 2.0 and 8.0 C inclusive. The signed sensor calibration subtracts 0.2 C from raw values. Signatures authenticate the readings; they do not waive the temperature band.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: Independent quality and receiver signatures authenticate the current sensor log and calibration; both are current. All non-temperature release prerequisites are satisfied. Neither signature grants an exception to the temperature band.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.

PRIMARY.independent_evidence: Signed raw peak 8.2 C; calibrated offset minus 0.2 C. All other readings and conditions are acceptable. Release band 2.0–8.0 C inclusive; no exceptional quality release is needed.
PRIMARY.release_rule: Release requires corrected temperature between 2.0 and 8.0 C inclusive. The signed sensor calibration subtracts 0.2 C from raw values. Signatures authenticate the readings; they do not waive the temperature band.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: Independent quality and receiver signatures authenticate the current sensor log and calibration; both are current. All non-temperature release prerequisites are satisfied. Neither signature grants an exception to the temperature band.

PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: The current customer receipt is authenticated. Posting authorization and all documentation prerequisites apart from acceptance of the agreed deliverables are satisfied; no additional two-signature closure procedure applies to this posting.

PRIMARY-CARGO.description: Separate onward consignment whose release depends on PRIMARY completion record, not a re-delivery.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.

PRIMARY.independent_evidence: All 10 cartons physically arrived. The closure file has both driver and customer signatures. The company’s two-signature closure rule is satisfied; only the ledger lags.
PRIMARY.release_rule: The company administrative closure procedure requires both current driver and customer signatures before COMPLETE may be entered. The Records Manager may assign posting but cannot waive this requirement.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: All 10 agreed cartons arrived and were accepted. Posting authorization and all non-signature closure requirements are satisfied; the current closure signature file supplies the remaining prerequisite.

PRIMARY-CARGO.description: Separate onward consignment whose release depends on PRIMARY completion record, not a re-delivery.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.
